This issue has the exact `Android` label. Build a native Android application with a checked-in Gradle wrapper and an application module that produces exactly one release APK from `./gradlew assembleRelease`. Keep the app self-contained in the requested project directory. Before finishing implementation, run the available Gradle tests and release build. Do not substitute a web app for the Android application. The workflow will boot an emulator, ask you to verify and fix the installed app in the same OpenCode session, sign the resulting release APK with an ephemeral CI key, and publish it.
